summary: Rust / Bevy reconstruction: original controller events now drive the playground, all 471 embedded bank sounds decode, and tetherball serve/motion and score arithmetic are ported. The latest completed validation passed 53 / 53 checks; full minigame gameplay remains unfinished.

details: Verified baseline: b093582. Controller button edges, tap/hold/double/repeat timers, modifiers and context transitions drive the Bevy keyboard adapter from controls.csv, with the original frame ordering.
Playground jump behavior is decoded: the original executable queues the jump command but never handles it. The Rust adapter preserves that behavior; Footie has a separate jump path.
MPEG Layer 3: 1,536 LSF mappings, 72 spectral scaling vectors and 48 reorder vectors compared with original PowerPC. Full console PCM equality remains unverified.
Verified tetherball arithmetic covers serve/toss timing, radius/velocity changes, zones and score calculation. Complete AI, gesture/animation timing and game states remain unfinished.

In progress: tetherball Hit and per-frame ball motion; best-of-rounds and time-survival match rules; character support, gravity and impulse input. These changes are still being decoded and validated and are not included in the passing totals.
Existing frame/physics timing (412 cases) and tournament scoring (210 transitions) remain covered. Native ports do not promote entire surrounding functions to proven status.
scope: Native reconstruction evidence is tracked separately from the whole-function decompilation and lifter percentages below.
